repos_data.description: Open-source C++17 engine for backtesting and forward execution, with a versioned C ABI; Pine Script v6 runs through code generation. Against TradingView's own trade lists, all 7,989 graded probes (309 open-corpus strategies, 741 closed-test scripts) grade excellent or strong: 7,983 excellent, 6 strong. Apache-2.0.
